objective.findRadioRoom: Search the building: find the radio room

tx.signal: TRANSMISSION — Signal detected. Source estimated 120 metres away.
tx.mission: OBJECTIVE — Reach the facility to the north and recover a radio battery.
tx.unknown: ANALYSIS — Unidentified heat signature. It is moving.
tx.inside: OBSERVER — You're in. The radio room is north of the corridor.
tx.faint: ANALYSIS — Faint signal in the radio room. Not moving. Approach slowly.
tx.battery: TRANSMISSION — Battery recovered. A link is possible.
tx.extraction: EXTRACTION — Go back to the designated point, south-west.
tx.fast: ANALYSIS — Fast signature closing in. Don't stay in its path.
